text:
akshay: heads up — after the RBAC role refactor last night i'm seeing admin-level bindings still active for users who were SCIM-deprovisioned in tenant `acme-prod`. caught it from the audit stream: 

akshay: audit: grant role=infra-admin user=svc-backup@acme-prod src=scim-provisioner trace=5a3c
akshay: audit: scim_event type=deprovision user=svc-backup@acme-prod external_id=svc-backup-42 provider=okta

akshay: so deprov event happened but the role binding didn't get removed. looks like a mapping mismatch after the refactor (we renamed infra-admin -> infra-admins in the role catalog).

marie: hmm, sounds like the provisioner filter didn't translate old->new role names. do we have proof it's a name mismatch vs a concurrency race? any logs from the provisioner showing attempted deletes?

akshay: i checked the provisioner logs, see 2 relevant lines: 

akshay: ```
akshay: 2026-03-19T03:12:11Z scim-provisioner INFO reconcile: user=svc-backup@acme-prod found external_id=svc-backup-42
akshay: 2026-03-19T03:12:11Z scim-provisioner WARN reconcile: role mapping not found for role="infra-admin" -> skipping remove
akshay: ```

eli: that warning makes it explicit. refactor changed canonical role slugs but the provisioner's role mapping table wasn't migrated. this will leave stale role_bindings rows behind.

eli: quick query to enumerate affected bindings: 

eli: ```sql
eli: SELECT rb.id, rb.user_id, rb.role_name, u.email, u.status FROM role_bindings rb JOIN users u ON rb.user_id=u.id WHERE rb.role_name LIKE 'infra-admin%' AND u.status='inactive' AND rb.tenant='acme-prod';
eli: ```

akshay: ran that, returns ~27 rows (mix of service accounts + human users). attached sample in the logs.

ops-sre: do we have a reconciler / pruner we can run safe? i suggest dry-run first then apply. also scope to tenant + role to avoid mass changes.

eli: yes, use the scim-pruner utility. dry-run first: 

eli: `./bin/scim-pruner --tenant acme-prod --role-match "infra-admin" --dry-run --output /tmp/pruner-acme.log`

eli: after verifying, run with `--apply`. the underlying bug: role_mapping table still contains old entries but the code path now resolves only the new slug. I'll patch the migration to insert alias entries and add a fallback to look up historical slugs.

marie: patch should include: 1) db migration to add alias rows, 2) provisioner fallback to consult `role_aliases` for deletes, 3) reconciliation job that removes role_bindings for users where user.status != 'active' and role resolves to an alias.

security-oncall: please treat as P2. we need an audit trail for any manual deletes. document each pruner run and attach the pruner log to the ticket. if impact >100 users escalate to incident.

scim-bot: noticed 2026-03-19T03:12:11Z scim-provisioner WARN reconcile: role mapping not found for role=\"infra-admin\" (event id 9234c)

akshay: i opened a ticket: SEC-2026-314 with evidence and included the pruner dry-run output. i'll hold off on apply until the migration + fallback patch is merged.

eli: i'll do the schema migration this morning. estimated small downtime? none — just inserts into role_aliases. will also add a unit test that simulates a rename.

ops-sre: once patch is up, let's coordinate a short maintenance window for the reconciliation run across tenants that had renames this week (acme-prod, beta-corp). i'll prepare the runbook: backup role_bindings table, run dry-run, review, then apply.

marie: reminder to include KMS audit check: some service accounts are bound to key policies based on role names. ensure we don't accidentally remove bindings needed for automated backups. double-check `key_policy_bindings` table before pruning.

akshay: good catch — i'll cross-check key_policy_bindings for any of the 27 affected accounts and list exceptions.

security-oncall: assign follow-ups: 
security-oncall: - eli: migration + fallback patch (SEC-2026-314-1)
security-oncall: - ops-sre: runbook + reconcile job (SEC-2026-314-2)
security-oncall: - akshay: KMS cross-check + pruner dry-run review (SEC-2026-314-3)

marie: once done, we should add a test to CI that simulates role renames and verifies scim-provisioner can resolve both historical and current slugs. small step to avoid future drift. :thumbsup:

akshay: thanks all — i'll update the ticket after the KMS check.

ops-sre: ping when dry-run log is ready, we'll schedule apply in a low-traffic window.

eli: starting on migration now. will post progress here and link the PR.
